g.text: both as slope and thickness; here each is the quantity itself, over 10 quarter-on-quarter steps.

g.text: Note: Growth peaked at ×2.21 in Jul 2025 and has fallen every quarter since, to ×1.16. The band narrowed over the same period, from ×2.9 to

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: a floor of ×1.41, and has widened slightly since — but the narrowing is the disclosures arriving, not the method improving, and

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: TPD-D01 shows the same movement as evidence displacing inference. A ×1.16 quarter is still 82% a year if it holds, and nothing here
